title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount Triple Tier With Towel Bar Solid Brass | Fire Engine Red | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier With Towel Bar | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage to your bathroom with a 16-Inch wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and an integrated towel bar in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. Built with solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for strength and everyday use.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges for safety and a finished look
- Solid brass hardware with concealed screw mounting
- Multiple finish options available, including statement colors

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting: wall mount; concealed screws
- Assembly: not required
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws #8 x 1 1/4)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
